SVG Attributes Guide

Attribute Description
x, y Coordinates of the top-left corner (rect, text, image).
cx, cy Coordinates of the center (circle, ellipse).
r Radius (circle).
rx, ry Horizontal and vertical radii (ellipse, rect corners).
width, height Size of the element.
d Path data (commands like M, L, C, Z).
points List of coordinates for polyline and polygon.
viewBox Defines the coordinate system and aspect ratio.
preserveAspectRatio How the SVG should scale within its viewport.
clip-path References a clip path to mask parts of the element.
mask References a mask for alpha/luminance masking.
font-family Font used for text elements.
font-size Size of the text font.
font-weight Boldness of the text (e.g. bold, normal).
text-anchor Text alignment (start, middle, end).
